items.question: Do you charge extra for evening or weekend visits?
items.answer: No. We believe in clear, flat-rate pricing. You receive the exact repair estimate upfront before any wrench is turned.

items.question: What warranty comes with repairs?
items.answer: All parts and labor carry a 1-year 100% satisfaction guarantee. If the issue recurs, we return and fix it at no charge.
